latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text Editor Generator — rapidly edit videos via AI-powered text transcript.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and edit by modifying the transcript text.
- Automated cloud rendering pipeline with 1080p MP4 output, ready to post in about a minute.
- Connects to backend via API, handling credits, sessions, uploads, edits, exports, and state checks.
- Clear error codes and robust handling of user sessions and file uploads.
- Optimized for creators and podcasters who want to edit videos quickly by editing words, not timelines.
